name: vscode-operator
description: AI that operates VS Code like a real developer through Language Model Tools and a supported local MCP bridge.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test dist/test/mcp/accessPolicy.test.js dist/test/mcp/catalog.test.js dist/test/mcp/pathGuard.test.js dist/test/mcp/workspaceTools.test.js dist/test/mcp/processExecution.test.js dist/test/mcp/proxyRouting.test.js

VSCode Operator: Protect from External MCP
VSCode Operator: Remove External MCP Protection

vscodeOperator.mcpBridge.enabled.description: Enable the local MCP bridge that exposes supported policy-enforced external MCP tools.

vscodeOperator.mcpBridge.host.description: Host interface for the local MCP bridge. Non-loopback values are ignored unless vscodeOperator.mcpBridge.allowRemoteConnections is enabled in User settings.

vscodeOperator.mcpBridge.allowRemoteConn.description: Allow the MCP bridge to bind to a non-loopback host. Only the User-level value is honored; workspace settings cannot enable this.

vscodeOperator.mcpBridge.port.description: TCP port for the MCP proxy (the fixed port that MCP clients connect to). Individual bridge instances bind to port+1, port+2, etc.

vscodeOperator.mcpBridge.path.description: HTTP path for the MCP endpoint exposed by the local bridge.

vscodeOperator.mcpBridge.logPayloadPrevi.description: Log MCP request arguments and response body previews to the VS Code Output channel. Only the User-level value is honored; workspace settings cannot enable this. Keep disabled for confidential workspaces.

vscodeOperator.externalMcp.enabled.description: Enable the explicit policy-enforced external MCP tool catalog. Internal VS Code Language Model Tools are unaffected.

vscodeOperator.externalMcp.policyFile.description: Workspace-relative access policy file for protected external MCP paths. Invalid or unsafe values fall back to the default.

vscodeOperator.externalMcp.commandMode.description: External MCP command mode. Command tools are not exposed in this read-only milestone.

vscodeOperator.externalMcp.requireWorksp.description: Require VS Code workspace trust before future external MCP write, command, task, Git mutation, or debug-launch tools are exposed.

vscodeOperator.externalMcp.maxReadBytes.description: Maximum bytes returned by external MCP file reads, subject to a hard internal cap.

vscodeOperator.externalMcp.maxSearchResu.description: Maximum results returned by external MCP text search, subject to a hard internal cap.

vscodeOperator.externalMcp.maxCommandOut.description: Reserved limit for future sandboxed external MCP command output.

vscodeOperator.externalMcp.maxCommandRun.description: Reserved runtime limit for future sandboxed external MCP commands.

vscodeOperator.processTools.enabled.description: Enable vscodeOperator_runCommand/startBackgroundProcess/stopProcess. Disable to block all internal process execution tools.

vscodeOperator.processTools.allowedExecu.description: Executable basenames (extension-insensitive) that vscodeOperator_runCommand and vscodeOperator_startBackgroundProcess are allowed to launch.

vscodeOperator.processTools.defaultTimeo.description: Default timeout for vscodeOperator_runCommand before SIGTERM/SIGKILL escalation.

vscodeOperator.processTools.maxTimeoutMs.description: Maximum timeout a caller may request for vscodeOperator_runCommand.

vscodeOperator.processTools.maxOutputByt.description: Maximum captured stdout/stderr bytes per command or background process before output is truncated.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_readProblems
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Call this tool BEFORE attempting any fix, refactor, or code-quality task. It returns all diagnostics from the VS Code Problems panel (errors, warnings, hints) with file path, severity, message, source, code, and precise line/column range. Always read problems first when the user reports build errors, type errors, lint issues, or asks you to fix the codebase.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read the current VS Code Problems panel diagnostics.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of diagnostics to return

minSeverity.description: Minimum severity level to include. Default is warning (returns warning + error).

pathGlob.description: Optional glob filter for file paths. Supports absolute and workspace-relative globs. Accepts a single string, a comma-separated string, or an array of strings. Prefix a pattern with ! to exclude matches.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_activeEditorSummary
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Call this tool to get the currently active file path, language id, and cursor position from VS Code. This tool takes no input fields.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_hoverTopVisible
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Call this tool to query hover/type information at the top currently visible position in the active editor. This tool takes no input fields.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get hover info at top visible position.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_hoverAtPosition
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Call this tool to get hover/type information at a specific position in the active editor. You can optionally specify a workspacePath to query a specific workspace when multiple VS Code instances are connected.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get hover info at a specific line/column.

workspacePath.description: Optional: absolute file system path to the workspace. If not provided, uses the active editor's workspace.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_completionAt
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Call this tool to get LSP completion candidates at a specific line/column. By default it uses the active editor, or you can pass filePath to query a specific file. You can optionally specify workspacePath to route to a specific workspace when multiple VS Code instances are connected.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get completions at a specific line/column.

workspacePath.description: Optional: absolute file system path to the workspace. If not provided, uses the active editor's workspace.

filePath.description: Optional: target file for completion. Supports absolute path, or relative path resolved from workspacePath/current workspace.

triggerCharacter.description: Optional trigger character for completion (e.g. ":" for Lua method call, "." for property access)

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_executeCommand
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Call this tool to execute any VS Code command by its command id when no specialized tool covers the need. Examples: open a file (vscode.open), show a definition (vscode.executeDefinitionProvider), trigger a code action (editor.action.quickFix), or inspect symbol references. Pass arguments as the args array or as argsJson (JSON-encoded array string). The tool returns the command result as text. Prefer specialized tools such as vscodeOperator_hoverAtPosition and vscodeOperator_completionAt when available.

argsJson.description: Alternative JSON string for args, must decode to an array

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_debugStart
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Start a VS Code debug session by launch config name or inline debug configuration.

workspacePath.description: Optional workspace path to start debugging in

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_debugSetBreakpoints
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Set source breakpoints for a file by 1-based line numbers.

filePath.description: Absolute file path, or path relative to workspacePath/current workspace

workspacePath.description: Optional workspace path used to resolve relative filePath

clearExistingInFile.description: Remove existing source breakpoints in this file before adding new ones

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_debugControl
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Control execution flow of an active debug session (continue/step/pause/restart/stop).

threadId.description: Optional thread id for continue/step/pause actions

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_debugClearBreakpoints
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Clear breakpoints globally or clear source breakpoints for a specific file.

filePath.description: Optional file path for file-scoped clear (absolute or relative to workspacePath/current workspace)

workspacePath.description: Optional workspace path for resolving relative filePath

all.description: Set true to clear all breakpoints

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_debugGetThreads
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read thread list from the active debug session.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_debugGetTopFrame
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the top stack frame of a debug thread, useful for quickly finding current paused location.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get top frame of current thread.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_debugSnapshot
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get a one-shot debug snapshot: top frame, scopes, variables, and optional expression evaluations. Set compact=true for a short payload. Use this for execution context only; do not use it to determine whether the current stop is an exception. For exception-stop detection, call vscodeOperator_debugGetExceptionInfo.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get one-shot debug snapshot for frame/scope context.

maxScopes.description: Maximum number of scopes to fetch, default 3

maxVariablesPerScope.description: Maximum variables to fetch per scope, default 50

evaluateExpressions.description: Optional expressions to evaluate in current frame

compact.description: If true, return a minimal payload and skip scopes/variables/evaluations.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_debugGetExceptionInfo
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Determine whether the current debug stop is an exception and read stable exception-stop information from the active debug session. Returns a short payload with normalized exception fields.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Determine whether the current stop is an exception and read exception info.

includeTopFrame.description: If true, include a compact top frame summary.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_debugGetStackTrace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read stack trace from a debug thread.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_debugGetScopes
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read scopes for a stack frame.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_debugGetVariables
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read variables from a scope/variable reference.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_debugEvaluate
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Evaluate an expression in debug context.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_debugStatus
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get current debug sessions, breakpoint summary, and thread preview. Set compact=true for a short payload.

compact.description: If true, return only essential status fields.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_readFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read a workspace file's text content. Reads the live in-memory editor buffer if the file is already open (including unsaved changes), otherwise reads from disk. Optionally read only a 1-based line range. Content is size-capped with a truncation flag.

path.description: File path, absolute or relative to workspacePath/workspace root.

workspacePath.description: Absolute workspace root to resolve a relative path against, when multiple workspace folders are open.

startLine.description: 1-based first line to read (inclusive). Omit to read from the start.

endLine.description: 1-based last line to read (inclusive). Omit to read to the end.

maxBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes to return before truncating (default 200000, hard max 1000000).

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_writeFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a new file or overwrite an existing file's full content. Refuses to overwrite an existing file unless overwrite:true, and refuses to clobber an open editor with unsaved changes unless overwriteDirty:true. Blocked by deny/read-only access-policy rules.

path.description: File path, absolute or relative to workspacePath/workspace root.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

workspacePath.description: Absolute workspace root to resolve a relative path against.

createParents.description: Create missing parent directories. Defaults to true.

overwrite.description: Must be true to overwrite an existing file.

overwriteDirty.description: Must be true to overwrite a file that has unsaved editor changes.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_applyTextEdits
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Apply one or more precise line/column range replacements to a single file through VS Code's editor edit API (undo-stack integrated, respects open unsaved buffers). Safer than writeFile for targeted changes to large files. Lines and columns are 1-based.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Apply precise text edits to a file.

path.description: File path, absolute or relative to workspacePath/workspace root.

workspacePath.description: Absolute workspace root to resolve a relative path against.

edits.description: Range replacements, 1-based line/column, applied atomically to the file.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_deleteFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delete a workspace file or directory. Moves to the OS trash by default (recoverable); pass permanent:true to bypass trash. Deleting a non-empty directory requires recursive:true. Blocked by deny/read-only access-policy rules.

path.description: File or directory path, absolute or relative to workspacePath/workspace root.

workspacePath.description: Absolute workspace root to resolve a relative path against.

recursive.description: Required to delete a non-empty directory.

permanent.description: Skip the OS trash and delete permanently.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_createDirectory
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a directory, including missing parent directories, inside the workspace.

path.description: Directory path, absolute or relative to workspacePath/workspace root.

workspacePath.description: Absolute workspace root to resolve a relative path against.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_movePath
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Move or rename a file or directory within the workspace. Blocked by deny/read-only access-policy rules on either endpoint.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Move or rename a file or directory.

sourcePath.description: Existing path, absolute or relative to workspacePath/workspace root.

targetPath.description: Destination path, absolute or relative to workspacePath/workspace root.

workspacePath.description: Absolute workspace root to resolve relative paths against.

overwrite.description: Must be true to overwrite an existing file at targetPath.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_saveDocument
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Save a single open document by path, persisting its in-memory buffer to disk.

path.description: Path of the currently open document to save.

workspacePath.description: Absolute workspace root to resolve a relative path against.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_saveAllDocuments
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Save all open documents with unsaved changes. Call this before running a build/test command so on-disk state matches edited buffers. This tool takes no input fields.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_runCommand
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run an allowlisted executable with argument-array arguments (no shell interpolation) in a workspace-relative cwd, and wait for it to finish. Use for npm/npx/vite/node/yarn/pnpm/tsc/eslint, git, adb, gradlew/gradlew.bat, python. Returns exit code, stdout, and stderr. Times out and force-kills long-running commands; for anything meant to keep running (dev servers, adb logcat) use vscodeOperator_startBackgroundProcess instead.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run a command and wait for it to finish.

executable.description: Executable name or path, e.g. 'npm', 'npx', 'git', 'adb', or './gradlew'.

args.description: Argument list, e.g. ["run", "build"]. Never pass a shell string.

cwd.description: Working directory, absolute or relative to workspacePath/workspace root. Defaults to the workspace root.

workspacePath.description: Absolute workspace root to resolve a relative cwd against.

env.description: Extra environment variables merged on top of the inherited environment.

timeoutMs.description: Max runtime before SIGTERM/SIGKILL. Defaults to vscodeOperator.processTools.defaultTimeoutMs.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_startBackgroundProcess
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Start an allowlisted executable as a long-running background process (e.g. 'npm run dev', 'vite', 'adb logcat') and return immediately with a processId. Use vscodeOperator_readProcessOutput to read buffered output and vscodeOperator_stopProcess to stop it. Always stop background processes you no longer need.

cwd.description: Working directory, absolute or relative to workspacePath/workspace root. Defaults to the workspace root.

workspacePath.description: Absolute workspace root to resolve a relative cwd against.

env.description: Extra environment variables merged on top of the inherited environment.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_readProcessOutput
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read buffered stdout/stderr from a background process started with vscodeOperator_startBackgroundProcess. By default returns only output produced since the last read; pass fromStart:true for the full buffer. Also reports running/exited status and exit code.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read output from a background process.

fromStart.description: Return the full buffered output instead of only new output.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_stopProcess
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Stop a background process started with vscodeOperator_startBackgroundProcess (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL if it doesn't exit). Only processes started by this extension can be stopped.

languageModelTools.name: vscodeOperator_listProcesses
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List background processes started with vscodeOperator_startBackgroundProcess, with status, command, and start time. Use this to avoid leaving stale dev servers or logcat streams running. This tool takes no input fields.
